title: An operator creates a work item, finds it in the work list and releases it
description: POST /api/work creates an item with its criteria, replaying the create under the same idempotency key returns the same item, GET /api/work lists it, and POST /api/work/:id/ready releases it from the backlog. When the target is a checkout's e2e serve, its seed file is keyed by its own port, so another serve in the checkout never overwrites or removes it (GY-3666). A waiter for a host heavy-job slot names who holds it (GY-3773). A second holder takes a free slot without waiting while the first holder's ticket is still in queue/ (GY-3868). Once startup has completed, the board master status reads lists the new item (GY-4001). A CLI launched while the server serves another commit waits for the matching release instead of exiting (GY-4003). Host add offers to keep turbo or boost off across reboots, and the host row shows whether it is off (GY-4008).
